info.title: doubao-seedream-5.5 Interface
info.description: Create image tasks using AI models, supporting multiple models and parameter configurations

post.description:
- Seedream 5.5 (doubao-seedream-5.5) supports text-to-image, image-to-image and image editing, including transparent backgrounds
- Supports 1K, 1.5K, 2K, and 3K. With `quality=3K`, setting `size=auto` or omitting `size` produces a `2880×2880` square, even with reference images. For a different shape, pass a preset ratio such as `size=16:9` or explicit pixel dimensions.
- Legacy model names `doubao-seedream-4.5` / `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite` are now routed to this model: when `quality` is omitted and `size` is a ratio, `auto`, or omitted, images default to 2K in jpeg format (png for transparent backgrounds); parameters this model does not support (4K, several images per request, more than 10 reference images, web search via `model_params.tools`, etc.) return an error. The same 3K sizing and billing rules apply to these names
- Processing is asynchronous. Use the returned task ID to [query task status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated image links are valid for 7 days; save them promptly

### Billing

- Charges are based on the actual number of generated images
- Each output image is billed by its total pixel count: up to 2,610,000 pixels at the 1K / 1.5K tier (same rate), up to 4,624,220 pixels at the 2K tier, and above that at the 3K tier
- Reference images are charged separately from generated images

prompt.description:
Prompt describing the image you want to generate, or describing how to edit the input image

**Language support:** In addition to Chinese and English, Seedream 5.5 also supports Russian, Arabic, Filipino, Thai, Turkish, Korean, Malay, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, French, German, Vietnamese and Japanese.

**Length limit:** Up to `4000` tokens (about 2,600 Chinese characters or 5,000 English words); exceeding it returns `400` and is not billed.

**Recommendation:** Keep prompts under 300 Chinese characters or 600 English words. A longer prompt still fits the limit but dilutes the information, and the model may miss details, leaving elements out of the image.
prompt.example: A serene lake reflecting the beautiful sunset

size.description:
Output image size.

**Method 1 - Ratio format:**
- `auto`, `1:1`, `2:3`, `3:2`, `3:4`, `4:3`, `4:5`, `5:4`, `9:16`, `16:9`, `21:9`, `9:21`
- Works with the `quality` parameter to automatically generate an image at the corresponding aspect ratio and resolution, without manually specifying pixels

**Method 2 - Pixel format:**
- Width x height, e.g.: `1024x1024`, `2048x2048`
- Total pixel range: `[921600, 8294400]` (up to e.g. `2880x2880` or `3840x2160`); sizes above `4624220` are billed at the 3K tier
- Aspect ratio range: `[1/16, 16]`
- Both width and height must be greater than `14px`
- Explicit pixel dimensions take precedence over `quality`. The final charge is based on the actual output pixel count.

**Method 3 - Resolution tier:**
- Set `size` directly to `1K`, `1.5K`, `2K`, or `3K`. Passing `size=3K` alone produces `2880×2880`. If `quality` is also passed, the tier in `size` takes precedence.

Defaults to `auto` when `size` is omitted. The model determines the aspect ratio from the prompt, and `quality` sets the output resolution (with `quality=3K` the output is a fixed 1:1 2880×2880 image).

prompt_priority.description:
Prompt optimization mode. Only `standard` is supported and is the default.

Passing `fast` returns `400` with no charge.

image_urls.description:
Reference image URL list for image-to-image and image editing features

**Note:**
- Reference images are charged separately from generated images
- Single request supports input image quantity: `10` images
- Image size: no more than `30MB`
- Supported image formats: `.jpeg`, `.jpg`, `.png`, `.webp`, `.bmp`, `.tiff`, `.gif`, `.heic`, `.heif`
- Aspect ratio (width/height) range: `[1/16, 16]`
- Width and height (px) > 14
- Total pixels: `[196, 6000×6000]`
- Image URLs must be directly viewable by the server, or the image URL should trigger direct download when accessed (typically these URLs end with image file extensions, such as `.png`, `.jpg`)

output_format.description:
Output image format

**Options:**
- `png`: PNG format (default)
- `jpeg`: JPEG format

**Note:** With `background=transparent`, output is always png: omitting `output_format` automatically produces png, while specifying `jpeg` is rejected.

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the generated image

background.description:
Output background type. Defaults to `auto`.

**Options:**
- `auto`: The model determines the background from the prompt and reference images. `result_data[].background` in the task detail returns the actual type: `transparent` or `opaque`
- `transparent`: Generate a PNG image with an alpha channel. Supported for both text-to-image and image-to-image
- `opaque`: Generate an image with an opaque background

**When using `transparent`:**
- Reference images are optional. If provided, up to `10` are supported and they do not need an alpha channel
- Output must be `png`. Omitting `output_format` uses `png` automatically; passing `jpeg` returns an error

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback address after task completion

**Callback Timing:**
- Triggered when task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation is completed

**Security Restrictions:**
- Only HTTPS protocol is supported
- Callback to internal IP addresses is prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback Mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Maximum `3` retries on failure (retries after `1` second/`2` seconds/`4` seconds)
- Callback response body format is consistent with the task query API response format
- Callback address returning 2xx status code is considered successful, other status codes will trigger retry

model.description: The model name from the request; legacy model names are returned as sent

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled
